name: The Fall of Ossirian
label: Quest
description: The Fall of Ossirian: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A terrible menace has been laid to rest. The cruel Ossirian has been vanquished.
The denizens of Kalimdor would be relieved to know of this victory. Take Ossirian's head and present it to Commander Mar'alith of Cenarion Hold.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, friend, you have returned! And in one piece, I might add. What news do you bring from Ahn'Qiraj?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I offer you my highest commendation and your choice of an item of power, friend. You have done the people of Kalimdor a great service.
